_doc: Do not feed this into ordinary pretraining/SFT unless your loader explicitly extracts chosen responses and ignores rejected responses.
Use with a DPO/reward/preference training script.

sources.name: human-like-dpo
sources.note: Preference data for more human-like, fluent, engaging conversational responses. Best used for DPO stage.

sources.name: ultrafeedback-binarized
sources.note: Preference dataset for DPO/reward training. Improves helpfulness, response quality, and instruction alignment.

sources.name: ultrafeedback
sources.note: Fine-grained preference data. Useful for reward modeling, rejection sampling, or DPO-style alignment.
